description: I had a maniacally delightful time with the very small slice of Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster I got to chew on. The art style is gloomy and grimy while remaining very readable. The mixture of stealth game mainstays with Hollow Knight-stye platforming clicks together pretty seamlessly. Exploring and backstabbing my way through its sometimes tricky areas as I gradually gained access to new abilities kept things fresh. And seeing Age of Sigmar from a Skaven's beady little eyes makes it all seem new again. A bit moldy, maybe, but new.
